title: PCSS Notary Receipt
description: Regulator-ready signed enforcement receipt. Wraps a Verdict (§9) in a signed envelope for replay by a regulator or civil-society auditor. See PCSS §10.

bearing_id.description: Reference to the underlying Bearing envelope (for replay).

expires_at.description: Optional receipt expiration. Default: 7 years (covers most regulatory retention windows).

spec.description: PCSS version under which this receipt was generated.

value.description: Base64url-encoded signature over the canonical typed-data form of the receipt (EIP-712-style canonicalization).

key_id.description: Signer's key identifier. Resolves to a public key in the PCSS registry.

timestamp_authority.description: Optional RFC 3161 trusted timestamp authority identifier.

implementer.description: Registered identifier of the implementer that emitted this receipt. e.g., 'platform:roblox', 'app:bark', 'controls:nextdns'.
